cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
This will break if you have a second field in your model e.g.
```python
    class Model(BaseModel):
        baz: Literal[FooEnum.foo]
        boo: str
```
It will run `v.value` on `boo`
(And btw you should use another variable instead of a local `v`, which is confusing with the other one)
